stages.description: A situation recreates the recruit’s fear without forcing a single brave response. The first version centers on a private request and a small Guild Hall scene.
Choose participants, facility support, and a legal route. Compatibility affects options but never fixes the outcome.
Make a character-revealing choice with visible risks and at least one nonviolent option.
Apply memories, relationship changes, duty or expedition consequences, and possible recovery.
Return the choice later through dialogue, Union identity, equipment history, or a changed event option.

assemblyRules.contradictionRejection: Templates are rejected when required anchors are absent, consent rules fail, cultural authority is missing, or the same unresolved quest theme is already active.
assemblyRules.repetitionControl: The same category cannot be selected for the same recruit within three completed personal-quest chains unless a prior later-echo flag explicitly calls it back.
